limitations_and_boundaries: GANs are hard to train for structured high-dimensional data, leading to high-variance predictions with large errors in extrapolation.
GANs do not allow direct mapping of gene expression vector x to latent space vector z, making it difficult to generate cells with desired properties.
For structured data, GANs have not yet shown advantages over simpler variational autoencoders.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

methods.name: scGen
methods.protocol_description: Variational autoencoder combined with vector arithmetics in latent space. Encoder maps expression profile xi to latent representation zi; decoder reconstructs xi. δ vector estimated as avg(z_perturbed) - avg(z_unperturbed) after upsampling and downsampling to balance conditions. Model trained using ELBO loss with reparameterization trick.

methods.name: Preprocessing
methods.protocol_description: Filter cells with minimum 500 expressed genes, genes expressed in at least 5 cells. Normalize counts per cell, select top highly variable genes (6,998-7,000), log-transform. For cross-species, use BiomaRt to find one-to-one orthologs.

methods.name: Evaluation metrics
methods.protocol_description: Squared Pearson correlation (R2) between predicted and real mean gene expression. Silhouette width based on first 50 PCs. Cosine similarity.
